title: A video was released on Sunday showing Randhir Jaiswal, the spokesperson for India's Ministry of External Affairs, eating nuts during the BRICS leaders' summit in New Delhi.
text:
A video was released on Sunday showing Randhir Jaiswal, the spokesperson for India's Ministry of External Affairs, eating nuts during the BRICS leaders' summit in New Delhi."

"Jaiswal was seen eating nuts while Masoud Pezeshkian, the President of Iran, was giving a speech, and Abbas Araghchi, Iran's Foreign Minister, also appeared in the clip."

"India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13."

"New Delhi's 2026 chairship focused on the theme "Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation, and Sustainability," while promoting cooperation among Global South countries and expanding its influence on the international stage, pursuing a people-centered and humanitarian approach."

"This summit marked the first time India took the helm of the newly expanded BRICS, an organization that now includes 11 members along with 10 partner countries that joined in 2025.
